The app can also be used as a logbook of what medication you have previously taken and for what period. This can be helpful in connection with a doping control where information on drug use is required.

Among other things, it is possible to save your medical searches by sending them to your e-mail address.
Notice: The final responsibility for the decision to take medication lies with the person taking the medication. Thus, it is always you who is responsible for what you consume.
